stem.en:
Dildora expected the history test to focus on dates and names. ______ most of the questions asked students to explain why events happened, not simply when they happened.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Instead,
Likewise,
For this reason,
Moreover,

why.en: The test was different from what Dildora expected, so a word that replaces an expectation, 'Instead', fits.
why.uz: Test Dildora kutganidan boshqacha chiqdi, shuning uchun kutilgan narsani almashtiruvchi «Instead» mos keladi.
why.ru: Тест оказался не таким, как ждала Дилдора, поэтому подходит слово замены ожидания «Instead».

stem.en:
The town council approved funds for a new bus route that will connect the eastern neighborhoods directly to the main hospital. ______ residents of those neighborhoods will no longer need to change buses to reach the hospital.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: As a result,
Nonetheless,
In comparison,
Previously,

why.en: Not having to change buses is a consequence of the new direct route, so 'As a result' fits. 'Previously' clashes with 'will no longer'.
why.uz: Avtobus almashtirmaslik yangi toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri yoʻnalishning oqibati, shuning uchun «As a result» mos. «Previously» «will no longer» ga zid.
why.ru: Отсутствие пересадки — следствие нового прямого маршрута, поэтому подходит «As a result». «Previously» противоречит «will no longer».

stem.en:
The chess club's membership doubled this year. ______ the club had to move its weekly meetings from a small classroom to the school library.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Consequently,
By contrast,
Regardless,
On the contrary,

why.en: Moving to a bigger room is the effect of having twice as many members, so 'Consequently' fits.
why.uz: Kattaroq xonaga koʻchish aʼzolar ikki baravar koʻpaygani natijasi, shuning uchun «Consequently» mos keladi.
why.ru: Переезд в большее помещение — следствие удвоения числа участников, поэтому подходит «Consequently».

stem.en:
Some students prefer to study in complete silence and find even quiet sounds distracting. ______ others concentrate better with soft music playing in the background.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: On the other hand,
As an illustration,
Thus,
Similarly,

why.en: The two groups of students prefer opposite conditions, so a contrast phrase, 'On the other hand', fits.
why.uz: Ikki guruh oʻquvchi qarama-qarshi sharoitni afzal koʻradi, shuning uchun qiyoslash iborasi «On the other hand» mos.
why.ru: Две группы учеников предпочитают противоположные условия, поэтому подходит оборот контраста «On the other hand».

stem.en:
The first draft of Akmal's essay was nearly twice the word limit. To shorten it, he first cut every sentence that repeated an earlier point. ______ he replaced long examples with shorter ones, and the final draft came in just under the limit.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Next,
In contrast,
Nevertheless,
Yet,

why.en: 'First' starts a sequence of editing steps, and replacing examples is the following step, so 'Next' fits.
why.uz: «First» tahrir bosqichlari ketma-ketligini boshlaydi, misollarni almashtirish esa keyingi bosqich, shuning uchun «Next» mos.
why.ru: «First» начинает последовательность шагов правки, а замена примеров — следующий шаг, поэтому подходит «Next».

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Wild tulips are most diverse in the Pamir-Alai and Tien Shan mountains of Central Asia.
• Turkish and Persian people were the first to cultivate tulips.
• Between 1634 and 1637, tulip prices in the Netherlands rose in a frenzy known as "tulip mania."

The student wants to trace the tulip's history from its wild origins to the Netherlands.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Tulips grew wild in Central Asia's mountains and were first cultivated by Turkish and Persian people before tulip mania gripped the Netherlands.
First cultivated by Turkish and Persian people, tulips later set off a frenzy of rising prices in the Netherlands, known as tulip mania, between 1634 and 1637.
The Pamir-Alai and Tien Shan mountains are home to the greatest diversity of wild tulips.
Tulips became famous in the Netherlands, where their prices once rose wildly.

why.en: Tracing a history needs its stages in order: wild origins, first cultivation, then the Netherlands. Only the choice that starts in Central Asia's mountains gives all three.
why.uz: Tarixni kuzatish uchun bosqichlar tartib bilan kerak: yovvoyi kelib chiqish, ilk yetishtirish, soʻng Niderlandiya. Uchalasini faqat tarixni Markaziy Osiyo togʻlaridan boshlagan javob beradi.
why.ru: Чтобы проследить историю, нужны этапы по порядку: дикое происхождение, первое выращивание, затем Нидерланды. Все три даёт только вариант, который начинает историю с гор Центральной Азии.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Rustam built a solar-powered phone charger for his science project.
• It took him three weeks to build.
• Lobar built a small wind turbine for her science project.
• It took her five weeks to build.
• Both projects won prizes at the school science fair.

The student wants to contrast the amount of time the two projects took to build.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: While Rustam's solar charger took three weeks to build, Lobar's wind turbine took five.
Rustam and Lobar both won prizes for their science projects at this year's school science fair.
Rustam built a solar-powered charger, and Lobar built a small wind turbine.
Lobar's wind turbine, which won a prize at the fair, took five weeks to build.

why.en: A contrast of building time needs both times side by side: three weeks for Rustam and five for Lobar. Only the first choice gives both.
why.uz: Qurish vaqtini qiyoslash uchun ikkala vaqt yonma-yon kerak: Rustamga uch hafta, Lobarga besh hafta. Ikkalasi faqat birinchi javobda.
why.ru: Для сравнения сроков нужны оба срока рядом: три недели у Рустама и пять у Лобар. Оба есть только в первом ответе.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The axolotl is a salamander native to lakes in the Valley of Mexico.
• Unlike most salamanders, it keeps its external gills as an adult.
• It lives in water its whole life.
• It can regrow lost limbs, and even its tail, over a period of months.

The student wants to explain how the axolotl differs from most salamanders.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Unlike most salamanders, the axolotl keeps its external gills into adulthood.
The axolotl is a salamander that is native to lakes in the Valley of Mexico.
Over a period of several months, an axolotl can regrow a lost limb or even its tail.
Axolotls live in water from the beginning to the end of their lives.

why.en: Only one note compares the axolotl with 'most salamanders': it keeps its gills. The other notes describe the axolotl without that comparison.
why.uz: Faqat bitta qayd aksolotlni «most salamanders» bilan solishtiradi: u jabralarini saqlab qoladi. Qolgan qaydlarda bunday qiyos yoʻq.
why.ru: Только одна заметка сравнивает аксолотля с «most salamanders»: он сохраняет жабры. В остальных такого сравнения нет.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

source.licence: facts only, checked against the article; wording our own (no text copied; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0)

facts.claim: Unlike most salamanders, the axolotl keeps its external gills into adulthood: it is neotenic, reaching maturity without metamorphosis, and stays fully aquatic.
Axolotls can regrow lost limbs and tails over a period of months.
It is native to the lakes of Xochimilco and Chalco in the Valley of Mexico.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Last year, a neighborhood library in the student's town opened a "Library of Things."
• Visitors can borrow tools, board games, and sewing machines, not just books.
• Items are lent for up to one week.
• The aim is to help residents save money on things they rarely use.

The student wants to explain the purpose of the Library of Things.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The Library of Things aims to help residents save money on items they rarely use.
At the Library of Things, visitors can borrow tools, board games, and sewing machines.
Items from the Library of Things may be borrowed for a period of up to one week.
Last year, a neighborhood library in town opened a Library of Things.

why.en: A purpose is the reason something exists; only the first choice gives it: helping residents save money on rarely used items.
why.uz: Maqsad biror narsa nima uchun mavjudligi; uni faqat birinchi javob beradi: aholiga kam ishlatiladigan narsalarda pul tejashga yordam.
why.ru: Цель — причина, ради которой что-то существует; её даёт только первый ответ: помочь жителям экономить на редко нужных вещах.

instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Around 820, al-Khwarizmi worked at the House of Wisdom in Baghdad.
• He is generally thought to have come from Khwarazm.
• The word "algebra" comes from "al-jabr" in the title of his treatise.
• The words "algorism" and "algorithm" come from Latin forms of his name.

The student wants to state where al-Khwarizmi worked and when.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Around 820, al-Khwarizmi worked at the House of Wisdom in Baghdad.
Al-Khwarizmi is generally thought to have come from the region of Khwarazm.
The word "algebra" comes from a term in the title of al-Khwarizmi's treatise.
Al-Khwarizmi's name gave English the words "algorism" and "algorithm."

why.en: The goal asks for a place and a time of work: the House of Wisdom in Baghdad, around 820. Khwarazm is where he came from, not where he worked.
why.uz: Maqsad ish joyi va vaqtini soʻraydi: Bagʻdoddagi Bayt ul-Hikma, taxminan 820-yil. Xorazm u kelgan joy, ishlagan joyi emas.
why.ru: Цель — место и время работы: Дом мудрости в Багдаде, около 820 года. Хорезм — откуда он родом, а не где работал.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

source.licence: facts only, checked against the article; wording our own (no text copied; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0)

facts.claim: The English word 'algebra' comes from al-jabr in the title of al-Khwarizmi's treatise.
The words 'algorism' and 'algorithm' come from Latinised forms of his name (Algoritmi).
Around 820 he worked at the House of Wisdom in Baghdad.
He is generally thought to have come from Khwarazm.

stem.en:
For decades, the town's river was considered too polluted for swimming. After a new water treatment plant opened upstream, the water became steadily cleaner. ______ the town council voted last spring to reopen the old swimming beach for the first time in a generation.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Accordingly,
Even so,
Granted,
By comparison,

why.en: Reopening the beach follows logically from the cleaner water, so 'Accordingly' (meaning 'as a result') fits. 'Even so' would signal a contrast.
why.uz: Plyajni qayta ochish suv tozalanganidan mantiqan kelib chiqadi, shuning uchun «Accordingly» (yaʼni natijada) mos. «Even so» qarama-qarshilik bildiradi.
why.ru: Открытие пляжа логически следует из очистки воды, поэтому подходит «Accordingly» (то есть вследствие этого). «Even so» означало бы контраст.

instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
Critics often describe the novelist's prose as plain. ______ that plainness is deliberate: by avoiding decorative language, she forces readers to notice the small gestures through which her characters reveal themselves.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: Yet
Admittedly,
Thus,
Similarly,

why.en: The text answers the critics: what they call plain is a choice. 'Yet' marks this turn. 'Admittedly' would concede a point against the writer's own view.
why.uz: Matn tanqidchilarga javob beradi: ular oddiy deb atagan narsa ataylab tanlangan. «Yet» shu burilishni bildiradi. «Admittedly» esa raqib fikrini tan olish.
why.ru: Текст отвечает критикам: то, что они зовут простотой, — сознательный выбор. «Yet» отмечает этот поворот. «Admittedly» означало бы уступку критикам.

stem.en:
Most of the hikers' printed maps showed the trail turning left at the old bridge. The map on the visitor center's sign, ______ showed it turning right, an error that sent several groups the wrong way before the sign was repainted.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: though,
therefore,
for instance,
likewise,

why.en: The sign showed the opposite of the printed maps, so a contrast word, 'though', fits. 'Likewise' would wrongly mean the same direction.
why.uz: Belgi bosma xaritalarning teskarisini koʻrsatgan, shuning uchun qarama-qarshilik soʻzi «though» mos. «Likewise» xuddi shu yoʻnalish degan boʻlardi.
why.ru: Знак показывал противоположное печатным картам, поэтому подходит слово контраста «though». «Likewise» ошибочно значило бы «так же».

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
The proposal to keep the school library open later was popular with students, who wanted more evening study time. It would, however, require hiring two more staff members, and the school's budget was already stretched. ______ the principal agreed to a trial: the library would stay open late two evenings a week for one term, after which the plan would be reviewed.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: As a compromise,
To put it another way,
As a rule,
To illustrate,

why.en: The trial balances the students' wish against the budget problem, partly meeting both sides, so 'As a compromise' fits.
why.uz: Sinov oʻquvchilar istagi va byudjet muammosi oʻrtasidagi muvozanat, ikki tomonni qisman qondiradi, shuning uchun «As a compromise» mos.
why.ru: Пробный период уравновешивает желание учеников и проблему бюджета, частично удовлетворяя обе стороны, поэтому подходит «As a compromise».

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
Many people assume that a translator's main challenge is vocabulary, the search for the right word in the new language. Experienced translators, ______ often say that the harder problem is tone: a sentence can be translated word for word and still sound rude, stiff, or oddly cheerful in the new language.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

options.en: by contrast,
as a result,
in addition,
for this reason,

why.en: The translators' view (tone is harder) differs from the common assumption (vocabulary is the main challenge), so 'by contrast' fits.
why.uz: Tarjimonlar fikri (ohang qiyinroq) keng tarqalgan taxmindan (asosiy qiyinchilik lugʻat) farq qiladi, shuning uchun «by contrast» mos.
why.ru: Мнение переводчиков (труднее всего тон) расходится с общим представлением (главное — словарь), поэтому подходит «by contrast».

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Tardigrades are tiny animals that live in damp places such as moss and soil, and in water.
• When water is unavailable, they draw in their legs and form a dried "tun."
• In this state, their metabolism is suspended.
• They can survive without food or water for years.
• They become active again when rehydrated.

The student wants to explain, in order, the sequence of events that lets a tardigrade survive a long dry period.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: When water disappears, a tardigrade forms a dried tun and suspends its metabolism; it can then last for years and revive when water returns.
Tardigrades, tiny animals that live in damp places such as moss and soil, can survive for years without food or water.
A tardigrade's metabolism is suspended while it is in the form of a dried tun.
Tardigrades live in damp places and in water, and they become active again when they are rehydrated.

why.en: The goal asks for a sequence. Only the first choice gives the steps in order: water disappears, tun forms, metabolism stops, survival, revival.
why.uz: Maqsad ketma-ketlikni soʻraydi. Faqat birinchi javob bosqichlarni tartib bilan beradi: suv yoʻqoladi, «tun» hosil boʻladi, metabolizm toʻxtaydi, tirilish.
why.ru: Цель — последовательность. Только первый ответ даёт шаги по порядку: вода исчезает, образуется «tun», обмен веществ замирает, выживание, оживление.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

source.licence: facts only, checked against the article; wording our own (no text copied; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0)

facts.claim: Tardigrades are tiny animals, usually about 0.5 mm long; most species live in damp places such as mosses, soil and leaf litter, and others in fresh water and the sea.
When water is unavailable, tardigrades draw in their legs and form a dried 'tun' (cryptobiosis).
In cryptobiosis their metabolism is suspended, and they can go without food or water for years.
They become active again when rehydrated.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Two students tested two paper airplane designs.
• Design A, with wide wings, flew an average of 9 meters.
• Design B, with narrow wings, flew an average of 14 meters.
• Design A stayed in the air longer: an average of 3.1 seconds, compared with 2.2 seconds for Design B.

The student wants to present a trade-off between the two designs.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Design B flew farther (14 meters versus 9), but Design A stayed in the air longer (3.1 seconds versus 2.2).
Design B, which had narrow wings, flew an average of 14 meters, five meters farther than Design A, which had wide wings.
Two students tested two paper airplane designs, measuring how far and how long each one flew.
Design A had wide wings, while Design B had narrow wings, which affected their flights.

why.en: A trade-off means each design wins on a different measure. Only the choice with B ahead in distance and A ahead in time shows both sides.
why.uz: Murosa (trade-off) har bir loyiha boshqa koʻrsatkichda ustun degani. Ikki tomonni faqat B masofada, A esa havoda turish vaqtida ustun deyilgan javob koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: Компромисс (trade-off) — каждая модель лучше по своему показателю. Что B летит дальше, а A дольше держится в воздухе, показывает только один вариант.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Paper was known and used in Samarkand by the 8th century.
• An 11th-century historian wrote that Chinese prisoners captured at the Battle of Talas in 751 brought papermaking to Samarkand.
• Archaeological evidence shows that paper was in use in Samarkand decades before 751.
• Paper was being made in Baghdad by 793.

The student wants to present the prisoner story while noting why some historians doubt it.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: An 11th-century historian credited prisoners taken in 751 with bringing papermaking to Samarkand, but evidence shows paper was used there decades earlier.
According to an 11th-century historian, papermaking reached Samarkand through Chinese prisoners captured at the Battle of Talas in 751.
Archaeological evidence shows that paper was already being used in Samarkand decades before the year 751.
Paper was known in Samarkand by the 8th century, and it was being made in Baghdad by 793.

why.en: The goal has two parts: the story and the reason to doubt it. The second choice gives only the story; the third only the evidence.
why.uz: Maqsad ikki qismli: hikoya va unga shubha sababi. Ikkinchi javobda faqat hikoya, uchinchisida faqat dalil bor. Ikkalasi birinchi javobda.
why.ru: У цели две части: рассказ и причина сомнений. Во втором ответе только рассказ, в третьем только довод. Обе части — в первом.

facts.claim: Paper was known and used in Samarkand by the 8th century.

The 11th-century historian al-Tha'alibi wrote that Chinese prisoners captured at the Battle of Talas in 751 introduced papermaking to Samarkand; the historian Jonathan Bloom judges this unlikely, since archaeological evidence shows paper in use there decades before 751.
Paper was being made in Baghdad by 793.

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Monarch butterflies in eastern North America fly south each autumn.
• They spend the winter at sites in central Mexico.
• The butterflies that fly south are not the ones that flew north months earlier.
• The journey north is completed over several generations.

The student wants to emphasize that no single monarch completes the whole round trip.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Because the trip north takes several generations, the monarchs that fly south are not the ones that flew north.
Each autumn, monarch butterflies from eastern North America fly south to spend the winter at sites in central Mexico.
Monarch butterflies from eastern North America spend the winter at sites in central Mexico.
Every year, monarchs from eastern North America make a very long journey to Mexico and back.

why.en: Only the first choice shows that different butterflies make different parts of the journey, so none of them does the whole round trip.
why.uz: Faqat birinchi javob safarning turli qismlarini turli kapalaklar bosib oʻtishini koʻrsatadi, demak hech biri butun yoʻlni bosmaydi.
why.ru: Только первый ответ показывает, что разные части пути проходят разные бабочки, значит, ни одна не совершает весь путь туда и обратно.

The butterflies that fly south are not the ones that flew north; the return north takes several generations.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• A school is deciding how to spend a donation.
• Plan 1: buy new laptops for the computer lab.
• Plan 2: renovate the library's reading room.
• Plan 1 would serve more classes each day.
• In a school survey, most students preferred Plan 2.

The student wants to acknowledge an advantage of Plan 1 while making a case for Plan 2.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Although new laptops would serve more classes each day, the school should renovate the reading room, which most students preferred.
The school is deciding whether to spend a donation on new laptops or on a renovated reading room.
New laptops for the computer lab would serve more classes each day, so they are the better choice.
Most students preferred renovating the library's reading room, according to a school survey.

why.en: The goal needs two moves: grant Plan 1's strength (more classes served) and then argue for Plan 2. Only the first choice does both.
why.uz: Maqsad ikki harakatni talab qiladi: 1-rejaning afzalligini tan olish (koʻproq sinf) va 2-reja foydasiga dalil. Ikkalasi faqat birinchi javobda.
why.ru: Нужны два шага: признать плюс плана 1 (больше классов) и затем выступить за план 2. Оба есть только в первом ответе.
